mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, display_name, role, active, last_food_upload_at, created_at FROM app_user ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_food_upload_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE username = #{username} AND active = TRUE AND ( last_food_upload_at IS NULL OR last_food_upload_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 3 DAY) )
